rows.text: In the Rajya Sabha reference on the countermanding of the Meham bye-election, Shri Raj Mohan Gandhi (Uttar Pradesh) said: 'The Prime Minister in his capacity as President of the Janata dal, wrote to the Election Commissioner after the first terrible incident took place and demanded, on behalf of our party, arepoll' (so printed).
